data.name: HelpText
data.value:
🤖 Bot Commands
- /billing — Show usage statistics. **(Admins & Owner only)** - /model — Select AI model for responses. - /provider — Select AI provider strategy (Auto/OpenAI/Gemini). - /draw <prompt> — Generate image by description. You can also just send a text prompt asking to draw something, and the image will be generated. **<Required>** - /lang [language] — Change language. **[Optional]** - /help — Show the list of available commands. - /restart — Restart bot. **(Admins & Owner only)**
